_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d7; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint Part J: the investigator's note per card when first pinned ('first'), once a related thread or deduction is known ('after'), and when confirmed ('final'). Deduction 'final' notes show mid-game, so none of them names the investigator. figure / nia 'final' show only after the Finale; case_request 'final' only after the A2 accusation.

cards.title: Who rang the bell?
cards.first: The rope never moved. The bell rang anyway.
cards.final: The bell was a broadcast, not a warning.

cards.title: The stopped clocks
cards.final: The clocks froze. The night didn't.

cards.title: The figure with the staff
cards.first: A staff at Nia's door. A name scraped from the register.
cards.after: The same tools cross the river.

cards.title: The dry river
cards.first: The river vanished from the surface.
cards.final: The sluice fed the river to the lantern.

cards.title: The 2:31 watch
cards.final: The village clock cannot be trusted.

cards.title: The carried child
cards.first: A silver hairclip on the walker's coat.
cards.after: Reveals Nia as the carried child.
cards.final: The apprentice carried his sister to the machine.

cards.title: The Echo Lantern
cards.first: The Echo Lantern stores and transfers memory.
cards.final: The machine could bind many minds at once.

cards.title: The altered records
cards.after: The purge answers to the apprentice staff.
cards.final: He erased himself. Name, face, record.

cards.title: The master console
cards.first: The console logged an activation at 2:17.
cards.final: Elias Vane opened Veyra. Then he walked away. Where to?

cards.title: THE FIGURE
cards.first: Same outline appears near every major clue.
cards.after: Tools match the apprentice's. So does the coat.

cards.title: NIA VANE
cards.first: Clinic card in the sickroom register.
cards.after: Matches the child carried in the figure scene.
cards.final: Elias's motive for the forbidden experiment.

cards.title: THE CASE REQUEST
cards.first: Unsigned. Found in my lantern case.
cards.final: Same hand as the apprentice log. Same hand as this casebook.

_titleNote: Card titles for sis_1..mom_3 are short labels (not in the blueprint); THE FIGURE / NIA VANE / THE CASE REQUEST are from Part J.
